title: Art Regardless of Medium

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Darlin', you here visitin' or you here to come home?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Darlin', you here visitin' or you here to come home?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ol' Finn, huh? Well, young Finn. Old soul young body. Glad to hear he's still shufflin' round the airwaves. Why's he got you looking for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ol' Finn, huh? Well, young Finn. Old soul young body. Glad to hear he's still shufflin' round the airwaves. Why's he got you looking for me?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Possibly. Art is art regardless of medium. What's the painting about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Possibly. Art is art regardless of medium. What's the painting about?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Interesting. Sounds like a collector's item of sorts. He wanna sell it and have me do an ad for him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting. Sounds like a collector's item of sorts. He wanna sell it and have me do an ad for him?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Hahaha. Darlin' how you supposed to find it then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha. Darlin' how you supposed to find it then?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Shouldn't there at least be a bit of mystery?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shouldn't there at least be a bit of mystery?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Too much business in you. Should loosen up and let yourself enjoy things a bit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too much business in you. Should loosen up and let yourself enjoy things a bit.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ask away. I have a very skilled tongue.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ask away. I have a very skilled tongue.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Detectives on a Train. Yeah, I know it. Had it for years until it got lifted by an opportunistic jackass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Detectives on a Train. Yeah, I know it. Had it for years until it got lifted by an opportunistic jackass.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Thought he didn't tell yah anything about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thought he didn't tell yah anything about it?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Mmmmm. Well, what it's actually called is Detectives on a Train. It was part of a limited series following this private investigator at different clandestine meetings.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mmmmm. Well, what it's actually called is Detectives on a Train. It was part of a limited series following this private investigator at different clandestine meetings.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Be a miracle if I knew that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Be a miracle if I knew that.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Well since you know the name of the print and the series, look it up in the compendium.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well since you know the name of the print and the series, look it up in the compendium.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: It's, like, an artist's compendium, you know? A portfolio but more of a record? The singularity was shit so we had to do something, Darlin'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's, like, an artist's compendium, you know? A portfolio but more of a record? The singularity was shit so we had to do something, Darlin'.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Some at one of the universities could get it for you. Find a student or a professor. They should be willing to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some at one of the universities could get it for you. Find a student or a professor. They should be willing to help.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ad-hoc classrooms. Since there ain't no arts or humanity fundings anymore. Literature is being taught in book stores.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ad-hoc classrooms. Since there ain't no arts or humanity fundings anymore. Literature is being taught in book stores.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Music theory in headphone shops and record stores for those double majoring in history. Lot of those are in Hive Mall. Start there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Music theory in headphone shops and record stores for those double majoring in history. Lot of those are in Hive Mall. Start there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Finn Amano told me to find you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Finn Amano told me to find you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Finn Amano told me to find you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Finn Amano told me to find you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Depends on why you're asking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Depends on why you're asking.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found a jukebox with some music notes on it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found a jukebox with some music notes on it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I found a jukebox with some music notes on it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I found a jukebox with some music notes on it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Said you'd know where to find a painting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Said you'd know where to find a painting.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Said you'd know where to find a painting.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Said you'd know where to find a painting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Said you'd know of a painting that had the same.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Said you'd know of a painting that had the same.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Said you'd know of a painting that had the same.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Said you'd know of a painting that had the same.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ... He didn't actually tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... He didn't actually tell me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not enough time for stuff like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not enough time for stuff like that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not enough time for stuff like that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not enough time for stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Only if you're open to a little interrogation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only if you're open to a little interrogation.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Only if you're open to a little interrogation.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Only if you're open to a little interrogation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Said it was from Mr. AG.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Said it was from Mr. AG.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Said it was from Mr. AG.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Said it was from Mr. AG.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He said it was called The Ballad of the Nameless PI.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He said it was called The Ballad of the Nameless PI.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He said it was called The Ballad of the Nameless PI.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He said it was called The Ballad of the Nameless PI.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you remember the music notes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you remember the music notes?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you remember the music notes?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you remember the music notes?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He didn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He didn't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He told me what it was called.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He told me what it was called.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He told me what it was called.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He told me what it was called.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Now what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the compendium?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the compendium?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where do I find that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do I find that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Reena.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Reena.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where would I find them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where would I find them?
